modules.responsibility: HTTP process entrypoint, listener configuration, and graceful shutdown
bounded HTTP workflow checks for local verification
routing, JSON boundaries, and status mapping
cross-aggregate workflow orchestration and atomic commit boundaries
mutex-protected in-memory persistence with atomic commits
public requests and stable error contracts

workflows.name: Register specimen
steps: decode and validate the public request
apply specimen identity and status invariants
commit the new specimen without replacing an existing catalog number
workflows.success: returns the registered specimen and a readable snapshot
workflows.failure: returns stable validation or duplicate catalog number errors
workflows.verification: workflowcheck registers a specimen and reads it through GET /specimens/{id}

workflows.name: Approve preparation plan
steps: create one draft plan for an eligible specimen
validate the approver and current draft state
commit plan approval and specimen preparation in one repository mutation
workflows.success: returns an approved plan and a specimen in preparing status
workflows.failure: returns conflict for an invalid specimen state or a second open plan
workflows.verification: workflowcheck creates a plan, approves it, and verifies both plan and specimen states

workflows.name: Log preparation progress
steps: load the approved plan and its ordered progress records
enforce monotonic percentages and completion rules
commit the entry and any terminal state changes together
workflows.success: returns the progress entry and marks the plan completed at one hundred percent
workflows.failure: returns conflict for a non-monotonic percentage or work on a closed plan
workflows.verification: workflowcheck records partial and final progress, then verifies completed plan and stabilized specimen states

workflows.name: Release for study
steps: verify the specimen is stabilized
verify that no unfinished plan remains
create the permanent release record and mark the specimen available
workflows.success: returns the release record and makes the specimen available
workflows.failure: returns conflict if the specimen is unstable or still has an unfinished plan
workflows.verification: workflowcheck completes preparation, releases the specimen, and verifies the terminal state

workflows.name: Publish specimen handling policy
steps: validate each matrix/risk restriction row and reject duplicate classifications
save the single editable draft with revision-based optimistic concurrency
freeze the draft into an append-only immutable version and consume the draft
workflows.success: returns monotonic published versions that stay readable forever
workflows.failure: returns conflict for a duplicate rule, stale draft revision, or repeated publish
workflows.verification: workflowcheck exercises duplicate rows, optimistic revisions, repeated publish, and version history

workflows.name: Enforce handling policy on plans
steps: resolve the latest published policy for the specimen's current matrix and risk
validate exposure range, adhesive whitelist, and peel strength cap
snapshot the evaluated policy version onto the plan and never re-evaluate it
workflows.success: creates or revises drafts only against an exact-matching rule and records the version
workflows.failure: returns conflict for missing policy or missing rule and invalid for out-of-range parameters
workflows.verification: workflowcheck verifies every boundary, version snapshot, and non-retroactive progress under a tightened new version

workflows.name: Concurrent policy publish and plan evaluation
steps: serialize plan evaluation and policy publication under the repository mutation lock
assign published versions monotonically and reject draftless publishes with conflict
bind every created plan to one immutable version that remains readable
workflows.success: every plan lands on an existing version and versions form a dense sequence
workflows.failure: losing publishers receive a deterministic conflict instead of duplicate versions
workflows.verification: workflowcheck races twenty plan creations against six repeated publishers and checks snapshots and version sequence

complexity.notes: Plan and specimen state changes share one repository mutation; duplicate catalog numbers and unfinished plans are rejected at commit time. Handling policies are append-only immutable versions; plans snapshot the evaluated version so releases never retroactively rewrite existing plans, and policy publication is serialized with plan evaluation under the repository lock.
